name: Serial Killer Speakeasy
description: Live true-crime theatre about four infamous American serial killers, with a themed cocktail for each, at Hot Five Jazz&Blues Club on 5 December at 15:00, 17:30 and 20:00. Over-18s only. Tickets from €27.
longDescription:
The Serial Killer Speakeasy is a 90-minute immersive show that tells four true-crime stories on stage, from the killers' own point of view. Bartenders and storytellers guide the audience through the cases of Ed Gein, John Wayne Gacy, Jeffrey Dahmer and Ted Bundy.

Each case comes with its own cocktail: Gein's Cauldron, Killer Clowns, Apartment Two One Three and Friendly Stranger. You can ask for mocktails at the venue.

The event is at Hot Five Jazz&Blues Club, Rua de Guerra Junqueiro 495, on Saturday 5 December 2026, with sessions at 15:00, 17:30 and 20:00. It's for over-18s only, and the venue isn't accessible for people with reduced mobility. Tickets from €27.

Cada caso vem com o seu próprio cocktail: Gein's Cauldron, Killer Clowns, Apartment Two One Three e Friendly Stranger. Pode pedir mocktails no local.

O evento é no Hot Five Jazz&Blues Club, Rua de Guerra Junqueiro 495, no sábado, 5 de dezembro de 2026, com sessões às 15:00, 17:30 e 20:00. É apenas para maiores de 18 anos, e o local não é acessível para pessoas com mobilidade reduzida. Bilhetes a partir de 27€.
